selection: Use completed CPU development evaluations only. Freeze one near-pose candidate and one full-pose candidate, even if full-pose development remains unsuccessful. Do not replace weights using held-out results.
freeze_requirements: Exact get-up/balance weights and configurations hashed
CPU evaluator, environment, protocol, C observer and new tests snapshotted
No further tuning using held-out results
success: Complete configured get-up timeout, 1 s unassisted dwell, 0.3 s handoff, then all 10 s balance gates with zero support, both wheel loads, no body/forbidden contact and original motor/physical knee caps. Failed or early-terminated episodes retained.
aggregate_acceptance: Every episode must pass to mark its tested scope passed. No simulation outcome marks hardware commissioning or deployment passed.
uncertainty: Spring force/pressure/hysteresis, inertia and drag are unmeasured hypotheses. Sensitivity is conditional, not a calibrated real-world envelope.
deadline: 2026-11-17T06:53:00+08:00; save completed and incomplete results honestly if budget ends
